summary: This 8-K reports the consummation of Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp's initial public offering of 10 million units at $10.00/unit, raising $100 million in gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-half of one redeemable warrant. The filing also covers the entry into related standard agreements (underwriting, warrant, trust, registration rights, letter, and private placement). This is a routine IPO closing for a blank-check company, not a special-situation event, as no business combination, target identification, or other transformative action is announced.
